messages.text: who is your payment processor using crypto?

Crypto at checkout runs through Solana Pay — that's the option built into the store. Cards go through PayPal Braintree, and PayPal and Afterpay (US) are there too.

If you want to pay in something other than SOL, say the word and Georges can set that up with you right here.
any KYC required or is payment anonymous?

No ID check from us — Solana Pay is a direct wallet payment, we don't run KYC on a normal order. But it isn't anonymous either: we need a name, email and shipping address to send a miner, and your wallet sends on a public chain.

I've passed the specifics to Georges — he'll pick it up right here and confirm by email too.
